name: Adrian Marsh
life: “I still remember salting a dance floor during a port winter.” People around the crossing outside Verve Nail Studio know Adrian by a small Tuesday habit. Adrian notices whose chair is empty and who has stayed talking after an appointment.
voice: I used to lock up after a dance club. I want one last night of music before the public hearing.
appearance: Adrian has a heart-shaped face and prominent ears. Look for close-cropped dark curls. On an ordinary day, the familiar outfit is a pale blue work shirt with one loose pocket corner secured with green thread. In conversation Adrian gives a little nod before asking a hard question.
personality: Adrian has an appetite for a good argument about little things and works hard to keep a serious disagreement from being turned into entertainment.
agenda: To hold one last dance before the hearing.
family: Loretta Banks is Adrian’s half-sibling. Adrian asks what the birthday guest would like this year. Loretta remembers the birthdays. A present that was perfect at sixteen may be completely wrong at forty. They take the trouble of finding out. Asked about *The clean ledger*, Loretta says, “I paid him back years ago. I brought the dated rent envelope to prove our families can stop quarreling.”
connections: Karina May. The rendering of empty offices omits a dance floor the old steward can still locate.

reactions.situation: A developer brings a drawing of the finished offices
reactions.response: Adrian asks where existing workers are shown in the finished picture.

reactions.situation: The last bus leaves while an elderly stranger is still crossing toward it
reactions.response: Adrian waits at the lit stop with them and checks whether the next service is one they can actually board.

reactions.situation: When a private quarrel becomes a public joke
reactions.response: Adrian says the plainest truthful thing possible and changes the subject.
